parameters.content:
## Create a welcome video for each signup

### How it works
Receive signup details or run the sample, personalize a landscape welcome video, and return the video URL and editor link. Optional SMTP delivery sends the result to the new user.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Set brandName, colors, onboarding cards, ctaText and ctaUrl in Config. Test with Sample signup first.
4. POST firstName plus optional plan, company and email to the production webhook. Allow enough caller time for rendering. Optional email requires SMTP and sendEmail=true.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/welcome-video-on-signup.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Prepare signup details

Use Sample signup for a manual test. The webhook expects firstName; plan, company and email are optional.

## 3. Save the editable draft

Save the project and return an editor link. dryRun=true returns the quote without submitting a render.

## 4. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 5. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

nodes.name: 6. Return the result and optionally email

parameters.content:
## 6. Return the result and optionally email

The webhook waits for the result. Configure SMTP and sendEmail before enabling welcome emails.

## 7. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
